formalExit.completionRule: Complete only when every one of the four Phase 1 exit gates passes.

gates.requirement: 100 percent of production datasets have a complete ledger entry.
gates.reason: The authoritative ledger is partially admitted. The Version 2.1 field audit separates 22 core rows from nine tracked optional enhancements and records 2/22 complete and admitted core rows; the universal 22-row criterion remains open, and optional permission risks do not block core completion.

gates.requirement: Every raw file has a checksum and can be re-fetched or restored from the archive.
gates.reason: The federal raw payload/manifest, four current-wildfire raw payload/manifest pairs, and the Québec 62-object archive have checksum-bound exact-version evidence. The exact NBAC payload now also has a durable exact-version primary readback and COMPLIANCE-retention receipt, but no recovery-replica proof. The canonical local inventory verifies 120 physical artifacts byte-for-byte across 17 complete local rows and one partial row, while four core rows remain unstaged. Local checksums do not prove archive restoration. The requirement is universal, and other raw files still lack the complete archive-and-recovery evidence needed to pass.

gates.requirement: The coverage geometry layer exists and covers all four provinces with a grade for every part of the land base.
gates.reason: The machine-checked coverage-admission record directly verifies graded coverage across British Columbia, Alberta, Ontario and Quebec while retaining its non-production boundaries.

gates.requirement: The validation suite fails a deliberately corrupted test dataset.
gates.reason: The synthetic corruption corpus is run in CI and asserts rejection for every listed corruption case.
